exposure: Idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (IIM) diagnosis status of the mother at time of delivery (post-IIM, 1-3 years pre-IIM, >3 years pre-IIM)
cohort: All singleton births in Sweden between 1973 and 2016 to women diagnosed with idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (IIM) between 1998 and 2016, and a comparison group of women unexposed to IIM.
finding: Women who gave birth after an Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathy (IIM) diagnosis had higher risks of caesarean section, preterm birth, and low birth weight compared to non-IIM comparators.
mod_finding: Post-IIM births had increased risks of caesarean section, and 1-3 years pre-IIM births had higher frequencies of both caesarean section and instrumental delivery.
